Test your skill in the dan

Offline: cards cannot be used.
Please take your card.

No more cards can be added.
Please take your card.

無法再新增卡片
請取回卡片

Please take your card.

此資料已經讀取過了
請取回卡片

Connecting...
~Play data may update late on a slow connection.
text.zh:

~網路狀況不佳時，遊玩資料可能延遲更新
text.ko:

Switching to offline mode.

You already spun today.

~*New cards need one play first.

text.en:
Closing time is near.
The gacha closes with the shop.

打烊後無法抽扭蛋
text.ko:

Please check the network.

請檢查網路
text.ko:

Please check the card reader.

卡片無法使用，無法進行大會扭蛋

The event gacha has ended.
~*Turn it OFF in test mode to return to normal.

大會扭蛋已結束
~※要恢復原狀，請在測試模式中將大會扭蛋設為 OFF
text.ko:
대회 뽑기가 끝났습니다
~※원래대로 돌리려면 테스트 모드에서 대회 뽑기를 OFF로 해 주세요

Connection failed.

~可能沒有拿到獎勵
~請在網站上確認

ごほうびを ゲット！

~New costumes are usable from your next play.

獲得獎勵！
~換裝從下次遊玩開始可以使用哦
text.ko:
보상 획득!

text.en:
Connection error.
~Closing the shop and going offline.

發生通訊錯誤

text.ko:

~상점을 닫고 오프라인 모드로 전환합니다
